body.label: Back of head
body.text: A heavy blunt wound to the back of the head. He was struck from behind, by someone he'd turned his back on.

body.label: Left wrist
body.text: His wristwatch face is smashed. The hands are stopped at 11:20.

body.label: Phone
body.text: Last message sent 10:44 PM, to Ruth: "Tea at 11 please." Every message from 10:55 PM on is unread, including Vivian at 10:55: "Are you reading it at midnight or not?"

body.label: Wallet
body.text: His wallet is empty except for a few receipts.

body.label: Left cuff
body.text: Strands of coarse gray fur caught on his left cuff.

body.label: Watch, up close
body.text: Look closer: the watch crown is pulled out. Someone set the time by hand before smashing it.

body.label: Coroner's note
body.text: The Deputy's coroner note: the blood had dried and the body had cooled. Death happened between 10:45 and 11:05 PM.

body.label: Inside jacket pocket
body.text: An index card: "Midnight: read Ch. 13 unless the wolf comes clean."

cards.text: A plastic skull on the bookshelf is hollow. Inside: Edgar's digital voice recorder, labeled "E. Thorne - sound effects". Its timer was set for 11:20 PM. Last file played: SCREAM_07.
A clean rectangle in the dust on the shelf, where Edgar's Golden Raven award always stood. The award is gone.
The French doors to the back porch are unlocked. A tuft of coarse gray fur is caught on the latch.
One muddy print on the rug just inside the French doors. Not a shoe. It looks like a big animal paw.
A half-burnt page pulled from the fireplace. The surviving lines are written in some kind of code:
A painting over the fireplace: "Three Ravens at Midnight". Edgar used to call it "my key to everything."
A sticky note under the desk drawer, in Edgar's handwriting: "Safe = the night it all began."
A wine glass on the side table, with dark purple lipstick on the rim.
A crumpled note in the wastebasket: "You stole my story. You'll pay for it. -G.P."
A framed book cover on the wall: The Hollowpine Girl, Edgar's first bestseller. Small print: "First published October 31, 1998."
A photo booth strip stamped 11:06 PM: Marcus, Vivian and Julian pulling faces. Marcus has wet hair, his werewolf mask in his hand, and sneakers on instead of his paw feet.
Party schedule on the mantel: 8:00 Drinks. 8:30 Dinner. Midnight: Unmasking, and Edgar reads Chapter 13.
A tea tray, set and untouched. Ruth's note: "Mr. T tea - 11:00", with 11:00 crossed out and 11:15 written in.
Muddy paw prints cross the kitchen floor, from the mudroom door to the back stairs. None lead toward the Great Room.
From the kitchen sink you can see the back door through the window, but not the far end of the porch by the study.
Edgar's place card. On the back, in his writing: "Tonight, everyone gets what they deserve. -E"
Taped under the seance table: a small Bluetooth speaker. A cue sheet next to it: "3rd knock: play WAIL_02."
Madame Oriel's business card. Tucked behind it, an old staff badge: "Doreen Fisk, Assistant to E. Thorne, 2014-2019."
The porch ashtray holds exactly one cigarette butt.
Muddy paw prints run along the porch, from the back door to the study's French doors, and back again.
Small sneaker prints in the mud under the study window.
The breaker box. Every switch is still ON. Ruth's flashlight sits on the shelf beside it.
A generator log on a clipboard: "Started 11:28 PM - R.K."
THE MANUSCRIPT. The Last Chapter by Edgar Thorne. Chapter 13 has been torn out. The margins are full of handwritten notes and rewrites, and the handwriting isn't Edgar's.
Wrapped in a wet towel: the Golden Raven award. A few coarse gray hairs are stuck in its base.
A letter from Edgar to Marcus Reed: "The audit is done. $340,000 is missing. Confess to everyone by midnight, or I read Chapter 13 aloud and call my lawyer."
Edgar's new will, signed last month: "Hollowpine Lodge goes to Ruth Kowalski. To my nephew Julian, my library card and my forgiveness."
THE 1998 PHOTO. Young Edgar and young Ruth by the lake, arm in arm. On the back: "Summer '98, my muse."
Marcus's bag: a pair of rubber werewolf paw feet, caked in wet mud. Under them, spreadsheet printouts with whole columns cut out.
Julian's bag: an IOU for $28,000 to "Lucky Lou", due November 1. Also $500 cash in a money clip engraved "E.T."
Vivian's bag: a co-author contract for The Last Chapter. Vivian has signed it. Edgar hasn't.
Graham's bag: a yellowed manuscript, The Hollow Girl by Graham Pike, 1996, with a publisher's rejection letter.
Penny's camera. The last photo, stamped 10:22 PM, shows Edgar alive at his desk, typing, taken through the study window.
Ruth's rubber boots by the door, size 7, still muddy. Ordinary boot treads.
A letter on Ruth's table, from Edgar: "The lodge is yours when I'm gone. Don't tell Julian."
A box of candles, half empty.
